## What's Changed * fix(voice): no hard-coded product name in correction context by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/374 * fix(voice): keep sending product field; gateway hides it from the model by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/378 * fix: Mac settings scrolling; English-only product strings by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/379 * fix(windows): release review C-group by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/377 * Kraki keeps running when launchd stops restarting it (Tentacle 0.35.7, Mac 0.2.60) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/380
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.59...mac-v0.2.60

## What's Changed * Archive: collapsed group inside the session list by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/373 * fix(mac): usage panel inside the Kraki window; visible shortcut; working Open at login by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/375 * Mac: kickstart the built-in daemon when launchd won't spawn it (0.2.59) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/372 * chore(release): Mac 0.2.59 (61) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/376
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.58...mac-v0.2.59

## What's Changed * iOS: readable crash reason, backslashes in paths, intro after first message (Mac 0.2.55) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/364 * polish(voice vocabulary): placeholder, ignored-line hints, cleaner layout by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/356 * diag: voice.summary correctionOn flag by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/365 * chore(release): Mac 0.2.56 (58) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/367 * feat: Claude / Codex subscription usage per account (tentacle + iOS + Mac) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/366 * chore(release): Tentacle 0.35.5, Mac 0.2.57 (59) — account usage by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/368 * Relay reconnect no longer marks running sessions as disconnected (seen at head restart) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/369 * Release review fixes (stability, safety, pairing, archive, relay hardening) by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/370 * Release Tentacle 0.35.6, Mac 0.2.58 (60) with #369 by @corelli18512 in https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/pull/371
**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/corelli18512/kraki/compare/mac-v0.2.54...mac-v0.2.58
